Maya K: Heads up — candidate VC-123 interview tomorrow 11am PST. I'm double-booked, can anyone cover product questions for panel A? I can still do exec + culture if someone takes product. @Elena R @Priya S
Elena R: I can take product, but only until 11:45 PT — ok?
Samir P: I can jump in for the whole slot if needed, but prefer to cover exec. Who's on platform?
Maya K: Thanks! Panel currently: Maya K (exec), Elena R (product), Priya S (platform). If Elena takes product, need platform cover — @Samir P can you take platform instead of exec?
Samir P: Yep I can switch to platform. @Maya K can you update calendar and panel list?
Recruiter Bot: Candidate VC-123 — Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 Calendar: https://cal.link/VC123 Panel doc: https://redwood.atlassian.com/VC-123
Priya S: Quick rubric q: for 'Ownership' do we use 1-5 or 1-4? Last week we had both in notes.
Maya K: Use 1-4, we normalized to 1-4 across eng interviews. I'll paste the snippet:
```
Debrief rubric (use 1-4):
- Product sense: 1 = poor, 4 = excellent
- Execution / CS: 1 = poor, 4 = excellent
- Ownership / Impact: 1 = no ownership, 4 = strong ownership examples
- Communication / Collaboration: 1 = unclear, 4 = clear + structured
Note: leave a 1-sentence justification under each score.
```
Priya S: :thumbsup: got it. Also running 10 min over? can we shift to 11:15 start? I need to join from home with kids' drop-off timing.
Elena R: 11:15 is fine for me
Samir P: Works for me
Maya K: Okay I'll update invite to 11:15 PST and add buffer in debrief. @Recruiter Bot can you send an updated calendar and add debrief doc?
Recruiter Bot: Updated invite sent (11:15 PST). Debrief doc: https://redwood.atlassian.com/VC-123/debrief — Zoom link unchanged.
Priya S: Thanks! One more thing — do we want to ask the candidate about scale tradeoffs in storage? I'll prepare 2 targeted prompts.
Maya K: Yes please, that'll be helpful. Everyone ready for quick pre-read? I'll drop candidate resume + 2 prompts in the panel doc.
Elena R: See panel doc, added a short note under 'Product prompts' — copied into chat: 'Design a metrics pipeline for realtime inference at 10K TPS.'
Samir P: LGTM. If anything else, ping here. /cc @Priya S :raised_hands:
Priya S: Thanks all — I'll be in the room 10 mins early to test audio.
